description: This Java source file defines an abstract factory class for creating pub-sub components using Akka actors, with support for distributed data extensions and configuration. It includes nested classes for data providers specific to different data handling strategies.

classes.name: AbstractPubSubFactory
classes.description: An abstract factory class for creating pub-sub publishers and subscribers with support for distributed data extensions, parameterized by message type.

classes.name: DDataProvider
classes.description: A static nested class providing a default implementation for distributed data extension creation, identified by a cluster role.

classes.name: LiteralDDataProvider
classes.description: A static nested class providing a literal data extension provider, identified by cluster role and message type.

methods.name: startDistributedPub
methods.description: Creates and starts a distributed publisher actor, returning a DistributedPub instance.

methods.name: startDistributedSub
methods.description: Creates and starts a distributed subscriber actor, returning a DistributedSub instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method for creating a DDataProvider with a specific cluster role.

methods.name: createExtension
methods.description: Creates a compressed or literal DData handler extension for the actor system.

methods.name: getConfig
methods.description: Generates a distributed data configuration for the given actor system.
